globalConfig.title: Global Configuration
globalConfig.desc: Edit logging, API, engine, and buffer settings. Changes marked with ⚠ require engine restart.
globalConfig.noConfigDesc: No working configuration loaded. Initialize one to start editing global settings.
globalConfig.logLevelHelp: Controls the verbosity of log output. Hot-updatable via PATCH /configs.
globalConfig.logFormatHelp: Output format for logs. text = human-readable, json = structured. Requires restart.
globalConfig.apiListenHelp: Address and port the management API binds to (e.g. 0.0.0.0:9090). Requires restart.
globalConfig.apiSecretHelp: Shared secret for management API authentication. Min 8 characters when listen is set.
globalConfig.apiRateLimitHelp: Maximum requests per second to the management API. 0 = unlimited.
globalConfig.apiAllowedOriginsHelp: One origin per line. Use * to allow all (not recommended for production).
globalConfig.apiTlsCertHelp: File path to the TLS certificate for HTTPS.
globalConfig.apiTlsKeyHelp: File path to the TLS private key for HTTPS.
globalConfig.engineDataBusSizeHelp: Internal channel buffer size for data point routing. Larger = more throughput memory.
globalConfig.engineWorkersHelp: Number of goroutines processing data points. 0 = auto (NumCPU).
globalConfig.engineShutdownTimeoutHelp: Graceful shutdown wait time before force-killing workers.
globalConfig.engineStaleThresholdHelp: Time after which a data point without updates is considered stale.
globalConfig.engineWriteRetryCountHelp: Number of retry attempts for failed transport writes.
globalConfig.engineCommandConcurrencyHelp: Max concurrent commands sent to a single driver.
globalConfig.engineDefaultTagIntervalHelp: Fallback polling interval for tags without an explicit interval.
globalConfig.engineOnBadQualityHelp: Policy for data points with bad quality: publish, drop, mark-and-publish, or alert.
globalConfig.bufferEnabledHelp: When enabled, data points are persisted to disk when transports are unavailable.
globalConfig.bufferMaxSizeHelp: Maximum number of buffered batches. Must be ≥ 10. Default: 10000.
globalConfig.bufferPathHelp: Filesystem directory for buffer files. Required when buffer is enabled.
globalConfig.pprofDisabledHelp: Disable pprof profiling endpoints entirely (/debug/pprof/*). Default: false (enabled).
globalConfig.pprofAddrHelp: Run pprof on a separate HTTP server at this address (e.g. 127.0.0.1:6060). No authentication — bind to loopback or private interface only. Empty = pprof on main API port.

nodeConfig.title: Node Configuration
nodeConfig.desc: Configure this node's identity and role in the topology. Auto-discovery is enabled when node ID is set.
nodeConfig.nodeIdHelp: Unique identifier for this node in the topology. When empty, auto-discovery is disabled and the node operates standalone (backward compatible). When set, the node broadcasts heartbeats and auto-generates topics.
nodeConfig.autoDiscoveryDisabledDesc: Node ID is not set. The engine operates in standalone mode without topology features. Set a node ID to enable auto-discovery, role-based routing, and auto-generated topics.
nodeConfig.roleCollectorDesc: Has drivers, collects data from devices, and publishes it. No upstream subscriptions.
nodeConfig.roleRelayDesc: Receives data from upstream nodes, processes it, and republishes to downstream consumers.
nodeConfig.roleAggregatorDesc: Receives data from multiple upstream nodes and merges streams into unified output.
nodeConfig.roleSinkDesc: Receives data from upstream nodes but does not republish. Terminal endpoint in the topology.
nodeConfig.subscribeEmpty: No upstream nodes configured. Add node IDs above.
nodeConfig.subscribeHelp: List of upstream node IDs to receive data from. The discovery module auto-subscribes to each upstream's publish topic when it comes online.
nodeConfig.topicPrefixHelp: Overrides the default "topo" prefix for auto-generated topics. Auto format: {prefix}/{node-id}/data/{driver}/{tag}

ruleProvider.desc: External rule-set providers. Rules reference them via match: "RULE-SET:provider-name". Provider list changes require restart; file content is hot-reloaded at the configured interval.

ruleProvider.nameExists: A provider with this name already exists.
ruleProvider.pathHelp: Path to the YAML file containing external rule definitions.
ruleProvider.intervalHelp: How often to re-read the file for changes (e.g. 30s, 5m). Leave empty to disable hot-reload.

ruleGroup.desc: Named sub-rule groups referenced via match: "SUB-RULE:group-name". Each group is a separate sub-engine. Circular references are detected at load time.

ruleGroup.nameExists: A group with this name already exists.
ruleGroup.noRules: No rules in this group. Add one below.
ruleGroup.ruleNameExists: A rule with this name already exists in this group.

ruleGroup.deleteGroupConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the rule group "{{name}}" and all its rules?
ruleGroup.usageHint: Reference a group from a top-level rule: match: "SUB-RULE:group-name". The sub-engine evaluates all rules in the group and returns the first match.
ruleGroup.ruleTargetsHelp: Comma-separated list of transport names (used by mirror action to fan-out to multiple targets).
